# Switch > On/off control with token-driven track, thumb, and press motion. This file matches the installed `switch` source. The online docs follow the latest release and may describe a newer version. ## Install ```bash npx shadcn@latest add https://control-ui.dev/r/switch.json ``` With `@ctrl-ui/react` instead of the registry, import from `@ctrl-ui/react/` where this file says `@/components/control-ui/`; this file then lives at `node_modules/@ctrl-ui/react/dist/docs/switch.md`. ## npm dependencies - `@base-ui/react@^1.9.0` ## Registry dependencies - `core` ## Exports - `@/components/control-ui/knob-contracts/switch-knobs`: `switchKnobs`, types `SwitchKnobStyle` - `@/components/control-ui/ui/switch`: `Switch`, types `SwitchProps` - `@/components/control-ui/ui/use-switch-drag`: `useSwitchDrag` ## Composition ### On/off control ```tsx ``` ## Usage ```tsx "use client"; import { CheckIcon, MoonIcon, SunIcon, XIcon } from "lucide-react"; import type { ReactNode } from "react"; import { useState } from "react"; import { Switch } from "@/components/control-ui/ui/switch"; import { Text } from "@/components/control-ui/ui/typography"; function Row({ htmlFor, label, children }: { htmlFor: string; label: string; children: ReactNode }) { return ( {children} ); } export function PrimitiveSwitchExample() { const [wifi, setWifi] = useState(true); const [analytics, setAnalytics] = useState(false); const [theme, setTheme] = useState(true); const [confirm, setConfirm] = useState(true); return (
} uncheckedIcon={} /> : } />
); } ``` ## Anatomy Scopes, their parts, and the state attributes each part carries. Selector pattern: `[data-skin="{skin}"] :where([data-slot="{part}"][data-control-family="{family}"])`. - `switch` - `root`: `data-checked`, `data-dirty`, `data-disabled`, `data-drag-checked` (`false` | `true`), `data-dragging`, `data-filled`, `data-focused`, `data-invalid`, `data-readonly`, `data-required`, `data-touched`, `data-unchecked`, `data-valid` - `thumb`: `data-checked`, `data-dirty`, `data-disabled`, `data-filled`, `data-focused`, `data-invalid`, `data-readonly`, `data-required`, `data-touched`, `data-unchecked`, `data-valid` - `thumb-icon`: `data-switch-icon` (`checked` | `unchecked`) ## Knobs Registered `--cui-*` custom properties with their recipe defaults. Set them through the component's `style` prop or a skin. ### switch - `--cui-switch-thumb-shadow`: `var(--shadow-sm)` - `--cui-switch-radius`: `9999px` - `--cui-switch-shadow`: `0 0 transparent` - `--cui-switch-background`: `oklch(from var(--foreground) l c h / 0.14)` - `--cui-switch-border-color`: `var(--control-boundary)` - `--cui-switch-border-width`: `var(--control-rim-width)` - `--cui-switch-checked-border-color`: `transparent` - `--cui-switch-hover-background`: `oklch(from var(--foreground) l c h / 0.2)` - `--cui-switch-checked-background`: `var(--primary)` - `--cui-switch-checked-hover-background`: `color-mix(in oklch, var(--primary) 90%, var(--foreground))` - `--cui-switch-thumb-radius`: `9999px` - `--cui-switch-thumb-background`: `var(--background)` - `--cui-switch-inline-size`: `calc(var(--spacing) * 9)` - `--cui-switch-height`: `calc(var(--spacing) * 5)` - `--cui-switch-padding`: `calc(var(--spacing) * 0.5)` - `--cui-switch-thumb-inline-size`: `calc(var(--spacing) * 4)` - `--cui-switch-thumb-press-inline-size`: `calc(var(--cui-switch-thumb-inline-size) * 1.25)` - `--cui-switch-thumb-press-scale`: `1` - `--cui-switch-press-background`: `color-mix(in oklch, var(--cui-switch-background), var(--foreground) 12.8%)` - `--cui-switch-checked-press-background`: `color-mix(in oklch, var(--cui-switch-checked-background) 80%, var(--foreground))` - `--cui-switch-thumb-backdrop-filter`: `none` ## Links - Online docs (latest release): https://control-ui.dev/components/switch - Anatomy contract: https://control-ui.dev/r/contract/switch.json
